brief:
An Israeli airtrike targeted a tent sheltering displaced residents at Al-Nuseirat camp in central Gaza on Monday evening, the Shehab Wire reported. Ten Palestinians were wounded in the attack, sustaining injuries that ranged from moderate to severe.

Al-Nuseirat camp, located in the central Gaza Strip, has swelled with thousands of displaced people fleeing violence elsewhere in the territory. The Monday evening strike marks the latest in a series of airstrikes that have struck displacement sites and civilian shelters across Gaza in recent months.
